title: Grok Imagine 2 image and video generator
description: xAI shipped Grok Imagine 2 with sharper photoreal images, longer 10s clips, and a Storyboard mode that converts a multi-shot prompt into stitched video output for X Premium subscribers.

title: Grok 3 API opened
description: xAI opened Grok 3 API access for developers with updated reasoning and coding capabilities, structured outputs, and a new tool-use surface compatible with the OpenAI Chat Completions schema.

title: Grok Think and Big Brain modes for Grok 3
description: xAI introduced Think and Big Brain reasoning modes for Grok 3, exposing chain-of-thought streaming and a budget_tokens parameter on the Responses API.

title: Grok Companions for iOS and web
description: xAI launched Grok Companions, persistent voice-and-text personas with customizable voices and memory, available to SuperGrok subscribers on iOS and grok.com.

title: PDF and document upload on Grok 3 API
description: xAI added native PDF, DOCX, and PPTX upload to the Grok 3 API and grok.com chat, with citation references back to specific page anchors in the response.

title: xAI enterprise console
description: xAI launched an enterprise console with usage analytics, role controls, and project-level billing separation, plus SAML SSO and SCIM-based user provisioning.

title: Grok 4 preview opens for SuperGrok
description: xAI opened Grok 4 in preview to SuperGrok subscribers and developer waitlist, citing improved long-context recall, stronger MMLU and GPQA Diamond results, and a tool-orchestration mode tuned for Codex-style agents.

title: Prompt caching on the Grok API
description: xAI rolled out prompt caching with explicit cache_control breakpoints and discounted cached-input pricing across Grok 3 and Grok 3.5, surfacing cache analytics in the developer console.

title: Grok dedicated tab in X for Web and iOS
description: xAI launched a dedicated Grok tab in X for Web and iOS with persistent threads, real-time post search, and a new Trending Topics digest.

title: Grok 4 API public preview
description: Grok 4 entered public preview on the developer API as grok-4-2026-02 with stable JSON tool calls, a 1M-token context window, and a new built-in code interpreter tool.

title: Built-in tools: web_search, code_interpreter, x_search
description: xAI launched first-party built-in tools (web_search, code_interpreter, x_search) on the Grok API, billed on output tokens with no separate per-call fee for SuperGrok keys.

title: Grok Vision beta
description: xAI introduced beta vision understanding with image-grounded chat and OCR-assisted reasoning, plus a screenshot-to-code helper for HTML/CSS scaffolding.

title: Colossus 2 cluster expansion
description: xAI announced the next phase of the Memphis Colossus 2 cluster build, scaling toward 1M+ Hopper-and-Blackwell-class GPUs as the training substrate for Grok 4.5 and beyond.

title: Grok 4 fine-tuning beta
description: xAI opened Grok 4 fine-tuning in beta with LoRA adapters, evaluation hooks, and per-key fine-tune billing, plus a documented preference-optimization loop.

title: Image generation API GA (grok-image-1)
description: xAI promoted its image generation API to GA as grok-image-1, with content moderation, customizable aspect ratios, and per-image pricing tiers.

title: Grok MCP server for IDE assistants
description: xAI shipped a first-party MCP server exposing x_search, web_search, and code_interpreter tools for IDE assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor with a one-line install.

title: Speech to Text API GA
description: xAI made Speech to Text generally available with batch and streaming transcription support across 25 languages, diarization, and word-level timestamps.

title: Grok 3.5 rollout
description: xAI rolled out Grok 3.5 with stronger coding evals and improved tool-use reliability, replacing Grok 3 as the default model in grok.com chat.

title: Grok Voice Think Fast 1.0 released
description: xAI released grok-voice-think-fast-1.0 for the Voice Agent API, focused on complex multi-step voice workflows, low latency, and robust tool orchestration.

title: Grok 3 API deprecation announced
description: xAI announced the planned API deprecation of grok-3 on August 15, 2026, recommending migration to Grok 4 (grok-4-2026-02) with a side-by-side migration guide.

title: API cost tracking in usage responses
description: xAI API responses now include exact request cost in cost_in_usd_ticks across chat completions, Responses API, image generation, video generation, and streaming.

title: Grok 4 GA on the developer API
description: xAI promoted grok-4-2026-02 to general availability with stable pricing, signed model fingerprints, an SLA of 99.9% on Standard and Pro plans, and a documented breaking-change policy.

title: Grok 4 Mini for low-latency agents
description: xAI released Grok 4 Mini as grok-4-mini-2026-05 with 256k context, sub-200ms time-to-first-token at p95, and aggressive pricing aimed at high-throughput tool-use loops and subagents.
